items.name: RedBot
items.title: RedBot — Turn Saved Links into a Useful Next Action
items.description: Choose one useful saved source, read the relevant passage and take a concrete next action with a mobile web beta or an AI-assistant skill.

items.name: DayCup
items.description: Get a coffee starting recipe for your equipment and beans, then keep your brew notes.

items.name: CleanPause
items.description: Pause device input while you clean your keyboard and trackpad.

items.name: EarBrief
items.description: Turn selected text and reports into audio you can listen to away from the screen.

items.name: Design Agent
items.title: Design Agent — Turn Visual References into Usable Interfaces
items.description: Turn visual references into focused interface changes, actionable implementation briefs and verified builds within the current project scope.

items.name: Project Rebuild Advisor
items.title: Project Rebuild Advisor — Know Whether to Repair, Recover, or Start Over
items.description: Project rebuild advisor that inspects a confused or inherited project and tells you whether to recover, clarify, repair, rebuild, continue, or stop.

items.name: Project Lessons Log
items.title: Project Lessons Log — Reuse Lessons Without Carrying Old Decisions
items.description: Project lessons log that records costly incidents, distills reusable lessons, and prevents expired decisions from contaminating the next project.

items.name: Iteration Cleanup & Handoff
items.title: Iteration Cleanup & Handoff — Preserve Decisions and Remove Dead Work
items.description: Iteration cleanup and handoff that preserves current decisions, removes superseded work safely, verifies a cold takeover, and prepares the next milestone.

items.name: Product System Map
items.title: Product System Map — Connect User Journeys to What You Need to Build
items.description: Product system map for ideas and codebases: connect user journeys, capabilities, responsibilities, missing paths, and buildable delivery slices at the scope you need.

items.name: Playlist Builder
items.title: Playlist Builder — Get a Verified Playlist You Can Actually Import
items.description: Playlist builder that turns a mood, scene, or seed songs into a verified playlist you can import to Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, or other services.

items.name: First-Time User Tester
items.title: First-Time User Tester — See Where Your Product Confuses New Users
items.description: Walk through a product as a first-time user and produce an evidence-led HTML report with task outcomes, prioritized fixes and concrete retests.

items.name: Prompt Cleaner
items.title: Prompt Cleaner — Turn Dictated Notes into Reusable Prompts
items.description: Prompt cleaner for dictated or mixed-language notes. Produce a reusable AI prompt while preserving corrections, examples, scope, and calendar-week boundaries.

items.name: GitHub Skill Publisher
items.title: GitHub Skill Publisher — Publish Skills and Track Discovery
items.description: Review a skill from the user’s perspective, learn from comparable skills, test improvements, and publish a verified GitHub product and install package.

items.name: AI Instruction Stress Test
items.title: AI Instruction Stress Test — Find Trigger and Behavior Failures Before Release
items.description: AI instruction stress test that simulates users and environments to expose trigger misses, skill collisions, stale assumptions, and silent behavior failures before release.

items.name: Decision Thinking Partner
items.title: Decision Thinking Partner — Clarify Ambiguous Choices Without Fake Certainty
items.description: Decision thinking partner that clarifies ambiguous choices, keeps real alternatives, recommends only when evidence supports it, and on request grills a build plan into a locked scope.

items.name: TaskDock
items.title: TaskDock — Keep Agent Work Ready to Continue
items.description: Keep agent work ready to continue: portable task identity, safe file organization, bounded resume and a readable private handoff page.

items.name: Stock Portfolio Brief
items.title: Stock Portfolio Brief — Decide What Changed and What to Do
items.description: Turn stock holdings and fresh filings into a source-backed portfolio decision, with index comparisons, thesis checks and explicit data gaps.

items.name: Podcast Video Maker
items.title: Podcast Video Maker — Turn Source Material into a Directed Conversation
items.description: Turn video, text or notes into a directed podcast conversation, with budgeted voice generation and lower-cost source-video lip sync.

items.name: Task Execution Coordinator
items.title: Task Execution Coordinator — Turn Intent into Verified Outcomes
items.description: Translate human intent into scoped work for existing owners, select relevant capabilities and evidence, and verify outcomes without adding a second task queue.

items.name: Work Memory
items.title: Work Memory — Recover Current Context and Learn from Outcomes
items.description: Recover current project decisions with sourced recall, outcome-tested lessons and read-only readiness reports that expose stale evidence and missing checkpoints.
